newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC sets up trans-Pacific M&A unit.
newsitem.headline: HSBC sets up trans-Pacific M&A unit.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc said on Monday its HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd, HSBC Capital Canada Inc and HSBC Securities Inc in the United States formed a Hong Kong-based business unit to focus on trans-Pacific mergers, acquisitions and corporate finance activities.

The North America Corporate Finance and Liaison Unit will target companies with North American and Asian business, principally helping clients from one region identify merger and acqusition opportunities in the other.
It will also provide corporate finance advisory services on prospective trans-Pacific investments to North American and Asian clients.

The three executives responsible for the new unit are Hoi Kwan, head of the North America corporate finance and liaison unit at HSBC Investment Bank Asia; David Mullen, chief executive officer at HSBC Capital Canada; and Guy Longobardo, managing director of corporate finance at HSBC Securities.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia, headquartered in Hong Kong, is HSBC's principal investment banking arm in Asia.
HSBC Capital Canada, based in Vancouver, provides corporate finance, fund management and investor immigration programme services.
New York-based HSBC Securities underwrites and deals in debt and equity securities and offers corporate finance, equity and fixed income services in both primary and secondary markets.
